$comment: The projects the front page lists, and where each one's version comes from.
Run `npm run projects` after changing this; it rewrites the block between the markers in index.html.

version.from is one of: deployed (url + dir: the project.json its deploy publishes; also supplies the blurb and picture) | package.json (path, relative to this repo) | submodule (path) | github (repo) | path (folder in this repo; last commit touching it).
shot.steps walks the page to the frame worth showing: { key } | { click: selector } | { scrollY } | { waitMs }.

projects.title: AlkoMax
projects.blurb: Search Vinmonopolet and Systembolaget at once — prices in NOK, the most alcohol per krone, and whether a trip to Sweden pays off.

projects.title: Celestial Alliance 3
projects.blurb: A space-opera RPG that runs in the browser — fly, trade, walk stations and cities, and hire a crew who remember you.

projects.title: Notar
projects.blurb: Compose melodies on a scrolling staff and play them in the browser.

projects.title: MineSweeper JS
projects.blurb: Classic Minesweeper, rebuilt for phones — long-press to flag, tap a number to clear around it, and best times and streaks for every difficulty.

projects.title: Bingo generator
projects.blurb: Create randomized wedding bingo sheets and download them as PDFs.

projects.title: Thank-you card generator
projects.blurb: Print-ready wedding thank-you cards — one photo, one message per card, folded to stand on their own.
